parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries no populated `members` array, no `structural_evidence` fields (all null), and no `fields_or_signature` data for either `Announcement.CodingKeys` or `Playcut.CodingKeys`. Without concrete evidence of shared members or a meaningful Jaccard similarity score, the subset-pair signal cannot be grounded in literal field overlap. `CodingKeys` nested enums are routinely generated or hand-written to match distinct JSON schemas for unrelated domain types (`Announcement` vs `Playcut`), making coincidental structural similarity the most defensible explanation.
